capture_authorities: Xcode Accessibility Inspector retry against the connected physical iPhone

privacy_boundary.notes: System pickers briefly rendered unrelated entries while navigating to the exact fixture. No picker frame or unrelated item was retained as evidence.

procedure: Enter the public partial query tab.
Focus the Additional Matches list before sending mirrored scroll events.
Scroll until repeated attempts produce the same terminal viewport.
Open the newly revealed terminal row tabbed browsing, wait for Word Detail to settle, and select Back.
results.observed: The list scrolled after it was explicitly focused. The stable terminal viewport ended with tabbed browsing. Returning from that row restored the same terminal viewport and scrollbar position.

procedure: Serve the repository-owned IMG-FIXTURE-001 over the local LAN and save it to On My iPhone.
Open only that fixture through Nihongo Files, select the result Share control, and select Copy Text.
Create a new device-local note, paste once, record the synthetic payload, and delete the note.
observed_lines: 今日は静かな公園で蝶々を見た。
問題を解いてから、友達と話します。
results.serialization: Copy Text preserved five visual regions as five lines. It removed spaces inside each region, preserved Japanese punctuation, the 12:30 colon, and the IMG-FIXTURE-001 hyphens, and included the English regions.

results.observed: Files access succeeded again with a purpose-created On My iPhone fixture. Camera and Photo Library mechanics remain excluded by the recorded stakeholder scope decision. No current clipboard-input claim exists; Copy Text output was proved without reading a personal clipboard.

completed_attempts: iPhone Mirroring returned only its macOS shell accessibility tree.

The inspector still exposed no selected Nihongo element or app hierarchy.
results.missing: The exact Nihongo hierarchy remains unavailable, but it is not a parity requirement. Zenbu owns and must directly verify its own accessible semantics.

results.missing: One direct physical-iPhone capture with the software keyboard forced visible.
